English: We had a pleasant evening with our friends.
The weather was pleasant, so we walked to the beach.
She has a very pleasant voice.
Portuguese: Tivemos uma noite agradável com nossos amigos.
O tempo estava agradável, então fomos a pé até a praia.
Ela tem uma voz muito agradável.

cards.meaning: Enjoyable, nice, or giving a feeling of satisfaction.

English: The rusty gate squeaked when I opened it.
The rusty hinges creaked loudly in the wind.
The bicycle chain was rusty after years in the rain.
Portuguese: O portão enferrujado rangeu quando eu o abri.
As dobradiças enferrujadas rangeram alto com o vento.
A corrente da bicicleta estava enferrujada depois de anos na chuva.

cards.meaning: Covered with rust or affected by oxidation.

English: She was concerned about her father's health.
I'm concerned about the cost of the repairs.
His parents were concerned when he didn't call.
Portuguese: Ela estava preocupada com a saúde do pai.
Estou preocupado com o custo dos reparos.
Os pais dele ficaram preocupados quando ele não ligou.

cards.meaning: Worried or anxious about something or someone.

English: I felt drained after the long meeting.
The cracked pipe drained the tank overnight.
She drained the pasta before adding the sauce.
Portuguese: Eu me senti esgotado depois da longa reunião.
O cano rachado esvaziou o tanque durante a noite.
Ela escorreu o macarrão antes de colocar o molho.

cards.meaning: Very tired; also emptied of liquid.

English: We need a scalable plan for a growing team.
The system is scalable as demand increases.
They chose a scalable design for the new service.
Portuguese: Precisamos de um plano escalável para uma equipe em crescimento.
O sistema é escalável conforme a demanda aumenta.
Eles escolheram um design escalável para o novo serviço.

cards.meaning: Able to grow or expand easily as demand increases.

English: Be cautious when crossing the wet floor.
She gave a cautious answer about the deadline.
Investors remained cautious after the announcement.
Portuguese: Tenha cuidado ao atravessar o chão molhado.
Ela deu uma resposta cautelosa sobre o prazo.
Os investidores continuaram cautelosos depois do anúncio.

cards.meaning: Careful to avoid risks or problems.

English: The flexible schedule is advantageous for parents.
It may be advantageous to book early.
Their location is advantageous for commuters.
Portuguese: O horário flexível é vantajoso para os pais.
Pode ser vantajoso reservar com antecedência.
A localização deles é vantajosa para quem vai e volta do trabalho.

cards.meaning: Giving an advantage or benefit.

English: My legs were sore after the hike.
The strap left a sore spot on his shoulder.
She had a sore back from sitting all day.
Portuguese: Minhas pernas ficaram doloridas depois da trilha.
A alça deixou um ponto dolorido no ombro dele.
Ela estava com as costas doloridas de ficar sentada o dia todo.

cards.meaning: Painful, especially from overuse or injury.

English: The course is demanding but rewarding.
She has a demanding job with frequent travel.
The customer was demanding a full refund.
Portuguese: O curso é puxado, mas recompensador.
Ela tem um trabalho exigente, com viagens frequentes.
O cliente estava exigindo o reembolso total.

cards.meaning: Needing a lot of effort or skill; also insisting on something.

terms.Portuguese: acima do peso; com excesso de peso

English: The doctor suggested more exercise for the overweight patient.
The airline charged for an overweight suitcase.
Some people are unfairly judged for being overweight.
Portuguese: O médico recomendou mais exercícios ao paciente acima do peso.
A companhia aérea cobrou pela mala com excesso de peso.
Algumas pessoas são julgadas injustamente por estarem acima do peso.

cards.meaning: Heavier than is normal, healthy, or allowed.

English: We received conflicting advice about the route.
The two reports contain conflicting figures.
She had conflicting feelings about moving abroad.
Portuguese: Recebemos conselhos conflitantes sobre o trajeto.
Os dois relatórios trazem números contraditórios.
Ela tinha sentimentos conflitantes sobre se mudar para o exterior.

cards.meaning: Not agreeing with each other.

English: He became withdrawn after changing schools.
She withdrew the money from her account.
The offer was withdrawn before we could respond.
Portuguese: Ele ficou retraído depois de mudar de escola.
Ela sacou o dinheiro da conta.
A oferta foi retirada antes que pudéssemos responder.

cards.meaning: Quiet and not wanting to interact; also taken back or removed.

English: She bought a sleek black laptop.
The new train has a sleek design.
He wore a sleek suit to the event.
Portuguese: Ela comprou um notebook preto elegante.
O novo trem tem um design moderno.
Ele usou um terno elegante no evento.

cards.meaning: Smooth, stylish, and modern in appearance.

English: A nail was protruding from the wooden board.
He noticed a branch protruding over the path.
The package had a sharp object protruding from one side.
Portuguese: Um prego estava saindo da tábua de madeira.
Ele notou um galho projetando-se sobre o caminho.
O pacote tinha um objeto pontiagudo saindo de um lado.

cards.meaning: Sticking out from a surface.

English: The picture looked crooked on the wall.
A crooked path led through the woods.
He gave us a crooked smile.
Portuguese: O quadro parecia torto na parede.
Uma trilha sinuosa atravessava o bosque.
Ele nos deu um sorriso torto.

cards.meaning: Not straight; also dishonest.

English: It was too windy to eat outside.
The windy road climbed up the hillside.
A windy afternoon scattered leaves across the yard.
Portuguese: Estava ventando demais para comer lá fora.
A estrada sinuosa subia a encosta.
Uma tarde de muito vento espalhou folhas pelo quintal.

cards.meaning: With a lot of wind; (pronounced differently) also full of curves.

English: The kitchen was messy after dinner.
They had a messy disagreement about money.
Her notes are messy but easy for her to understand.
Portuguese: A cozinha ficou bagunçada depois do jantar.
Eles tiveram uma briga complicada por causa de dinheiro.
As anotações dela são bagunçadas, mas fáceis para ela entender.

cards.meaning: Untidy or dirty; also complicated and unpleasant.

English: Jeans are appropriate for the casual event.
Please choose an appropriate example for the lesson.
The manager took appropriate action after the complaint.
Portuguese: Jeans são adequados para o evento informal.
Por favor, escolha um exemplo apropriado para a aula.
O gerente tomou as medidas adequadas depois da reclamação.

cards.meaning: Suitable or right for a particular situation.

English: The smaller suitcase is easier to carry and more manageable.
We broke the project into manageable steps.
The workload became manageable after we hired help.
Portuguese: A mala menor é mais fácil de carregar e de lidar.
Dividimos o projeto em etapas viáveis.
A carga de trabalho ficou administrável depois que contratamos ajuda.

cards.meaning: Possible to deal with or control.

English: This jar lid is too tight to open.
We have a tight schedule today.
The runner wore tight shoes that caused pain.
Portuguese: A tampa deste pote está apertada demais para abrir.
Temos uma agenda apertada hoje.
O corredor usou tênis apertados que causaram dor.

cards.meaning: Firmly fixed or close-fitting; also with little free time.

English: The charger is incompatible with my old phone.
Their schedules are incompatible this week.
The software is incompatible with that operating system.
Portuguese: O carregador é incompatível com meu celular antigo.
Os horários deles são incompatíveis esta semana.
O software é incompatível com esse sistema operacional.

cards.meaning: Not able to work or exist together.

English: It is likely to rain this afternoon.
She is the most likely person to know the answer.
We are likely to arrive before sunset.
Portuguese: É provável que chova hoje à tarde.
Ela é a pessoa com mais chance de saber a resposta.
Provavelmente vamos chegar antes do pôr do sol.

cards.meaning: Probably going to happen or be true.

English: The prize was an extrinsic reward for the volunteers.
Extrinsic motivation can come from bonuses or praise.
He cared more about learning than extrinsic rewards.
Portuguese: O prêmio foi uma recompensa extrínseca para os voluntários.
A motivação extrínseca pode vir de bônus ou elogios.
Ele se importava mais com aprender do que com recompensas externas.

cards.meaning: Coming from outside, not from within a person or thing.

English: The teacher is warm and communicative.
Good managers are open and communicative with their teams.
Her communicative style helped the group work together.
Portuguese: O professor é caloroso e comunicativo.
Bons gestores são abertos e comunicativos com suas equipes.
O jeito comunicativo dela ajudou o grupo a trabalhar junto.

cards.meaning: Willing and able to talk and share information.

English: After a year abroad, she became fluent in Spanish.
He is fluent in English and Portuguese.
The guide gave a fluent explanation of the route.
Portuguese: Depois de um ano no exterior, ela ficou fluente em espanhol.
Ele é fluente em inglês e português.
O guia deu uma explicação clara e fluida do trajeto.

cards.meaning: Able to speak a language easily and well; smooth and clear.

English: The restless child kept moving around the room.
I felt restless while waiting for the results.
She had a restless night before the exam.
Portuguese: A criança inquieta não parava de andar pela sala.
Fiquei inquieto enquanto esperava os resultados.
Ela teve uma noite agitada antes da prova.

cards.meaning: Unable to stay still or relax.

English: The seedlings were nourished by rich soil.
A balanced meal kept the children nourished.
She felt nourished after the warm soup.
Portuguese: As mudas foram nutridas por um solo rico.
Uma refeição equilibrada manteve as crianças bem alimentadas.
Ela se sentiu revigorada depois da sopa quente.

cards.meaning: Given the food or substances needed to grow and stay healthy.

English: The coffee near the station was overpriced.
They left the shop without buying the overpriced coat.
That restaurant is good, but the desserts are overpriced.
Portuguese: O café perto da estação era caro demais.
Eles saíram da loja sem comprar o casaco caro demais.
Aquele restaurante é bom, mas as sobremesas são caras demais.

cards.meaning: Costing more than it is worth.

English: The hotel was pricy, so we chose a smaller room.
Those headphones are a little pricy for me.
We found a less pricy café around the corner.
Portuguese: O hotel era caro, então escolhemos um quarto menor.
Esses fones são um pouco caros para mim.
Encontramos um café mais barato na esquina.

cards.meaning: Expensive (informal).

English: We need a reliable source for these figures.
Her old car is still reliable.
The train is usually reliable in the morning.
Portuguese: Precisamos de uma fonte confiável para esses números.
O carro antigo dela ainda é confiável.
O trem costuma ser confiável de manhã.

cards.meaning: Able to be trusted to work well or be accurate.

English: The view from the mountain was unbelievable.
It is unbelievable how quickly the children grew.
She made an unbelievable save in the final minute.
Portuguese: A vista da montanha era inacreditável.
É inacreditável como as crianças cresceram rápido.
Ela fez uma defesa incrível no último minuto.

cards.meaning: So surprising or impressive that it is hard to believe.

English: It was a daring plan, but the team succeeded.
She wore a daring red outfit to the party.
The climbers made a daring ascent before sunrise.
Portuguese: Era um plano ousado, mas a equipe conseguiu.
Ela usou uma roupa vermelha ousada na festa.
Os alpinistas fizeram uma subida audaciosa antes do amanhecer.

cards.meaning: Brave and willing to take risks.

English: Curiosity is an intrinsic part of learning.
The task has intrinsic value beyond its final result.
Intrinsic motivation helped her continue practicing.
Portuguese: A curiosidade é uma parte intrínseca do aprendizado.
A tarefa tem um valor intrínseco além do resultado final.
A motivação intrínseca a ajudou a continuar praticando.

cards.meaning: Belonging naturally to something; coming from within.

English: The sky looked gloomy before the storm.
He felt gloomy after hearing the news.
The gloomy room needed brighter curtains.
Portuguese: O céu parecia sombrio antes da tempestade.
Ele ficou desanimado depois de ouvir a notícia.
O quarto escuro precisava de cortinas mais claras.

cards.meaning: Dark and depressing; also feeling sad and without hope.

English: Teaching can be challenging but rewarding.
She found volunteering at the shelter rewarding.
Finishing the project was a rewarding experience.
Portuguese: Dar aula pode ser desafiador, mas gratificante.
Ela achou gratificante ser voluntária no abrigo.
Terminar o projeto foi uma experiência gratificante.

cards.meaning: Giving satisfaction or a sense of achievement.

English: It is unfair to blame one person for the mistake.
The referee made an unfair decision.
She felt the rules were unfair to new employees.
Portuguese: É injusto culpar uma só pessoa pelo erro.
O árbitro tomou uma decisão injusta.
Ela achava as regras injustas com os funcionários novos.

cards.meaning: Not treating people equally or fairly.

English: The court heard evidence about the consequential loss.
It was a consequential decision for the whole company.
Small choices can have consequential effects over time.
Portuguese: O tribunal ouviu provas sobre os danos decorrentes.
Foi uma decisão importante para a empresa inteira.
Pequenas escolhas podem ter efeitos significativos com o tempo.

cards.meaning: Important and having significant results; also (legal) happening as a result.

English: She is outgoing and enjoys meeting new people.
My outgoing message included all the travel details.
He has an outgoing personality at work.
Portuguese: Ela é extrovertida e gosta de conhecer gente nova.
Minha mensagem de ausência incluía todos os detalhes da viagem.
Ele tem uma personalidade extrovertida no trabalho.

cards.meaning: Friendly and enjoying meeting people; also going out or leaving.

English: We were astonished by the size of the old tree.
She looked astonished when they announced her name.
I was astonished to find the shop still open.
Portuguese: Ficamos impressionados com o tamanho da árvore antiga.
Ela pareceu espantada quando anunciaram o nome dela.
Fiquei surpreso ao ver que a loja ainda estava aberta.

cards.meaning: Very surprised.

English: An unpleasant smell came from the refrigerator.
The conversation became unpleasant after the accusation.
He had an unpleasant experience at the airport.
Portuguese: Um cheiro desagradável vinha da geladeira.
A conversa ficou desagradável depois da acusação.
Ele teve uma experiência desagradável no aeroporto.

cards.meaning: Not enjoyable or pleasant.

English: He was reluctant to share his personal details.
She felt reluctant to leave the party early.
They were reluctant to change the original plan.
Portuguese: Ele estava relutante em compartilhar seus dados pessoais.
Ela não estava com vontade de sair da festa cedo.
Eles estavam relutantes em mudar o plano original.

cards.meaning: Not willing to do something.

English: I felt overwhelmed by all the paperwork.
She was overwhelmed with joy at the reunion.
The small team became overwhelmed by customer requests.
Portuguese: Eu me senti sobrecarregado com toda aquela papelada.
Ela ficou tomada de alegria no reencontro.
A equipe pequena ficou sobrecarregada com os pedidos dos clientes.

cards.meaning: Having too much to deal with; also feeling a very strong emotion.

English: The intelligent dog learned the command quickly.
She asked an intelligent question during the lecture.
They designed an intelligent system to manage traffic.
Portuguese: O cachorro inteligente aprendeu o comando rapidamente.
Ela fez uma pergunta inteligente durante a palestra.
Eles criaram um sistema inteligente para gerenciar o trânsito.

cards.meaning: Able to learn, understand, and think well.

English: She is committed to improving public health.
The team committed to finishing the work by Friday.
He remained committed to his training plan.
Portuguese: Ela está comprometida em melhorar a saúde pública.
A equipe se comprometeu a terminar o trabalho até sexta.
Ele continuou dedicado ao seu plano de treino.

cards.meaning: Strongly dedicated to something.

English: The job is appealing because it offers flexible hours.
They chose the most appealing design.
The quiet village looked appealing to the visitors.
Portuguese: O emprego é atraente porque oferece horário flexível.
Eles escolheram o design mais atraente.
O vilarejo tranquilo pareceu atraente aos visitantes.

cards.meaning: Attractive or interesting.

English: The project produced tangible benefits for local families.
We need tangible evidence before making a decision.
Her support made a tangible difference to the team.
Portuguese: O projeto trouxe benefícios concretos para as famílias locais.
Precisamos de provas concretas antes de tomar uma decisão.
O apoio dela fez uma diferença real para a equipe.

cards.meaning: Real and able to be seen, measured, or proven.

English: It was naive to believe the offer without checking it.
He was young and naive when he moved abroad.
The naive plan ignored the cost of repairs.
Portuguese: Foi ingênuo acreditar na oferta sem verificar.
Ele era jovem e ingênuo quando se mudou para o exterior.
O plano ingênuo ignorava o custo dos reparos.

cards.meaning: Lacking experience and too ready to believe things.

English: Her analytical approach helped solve the puzzle.
The report gives an analytical view of the market.
He is analytical and careful with numbers.
Portuguese: A abordagem analítica dela ajudou a resolver o quebra-cabeça.
O relatório traz uma visão analítica do mercado.
Ele é analítico e cuidadoso com números.

cards.meaning: Using careful, logical examination of details.

English: The neighborhood has affordable apartments.
They found an affordable flight to Lisbon.
The clinic offers affordable dental care.
Portuguese: O bairro tem apartamentos com preços acessíveis.
Eles encontraram um voo barato para Lisboa.
A clínica oferece tratamento odontológico acessível.

cards.meaning: Cheap enough for people to be able to buy.

terms.Portuguese: com que dá para se identificar; identificável

English: The character feels relatable because she makes ordinary mistakes.
His story about learning a new language was relatable to me.
The film's relatable humor made the audience laugh.
Portuguese: É fácil se identificar com a personagem porque ela comete erros comuns.
Eu me identifiquei com a história dele sobre aprender um novo idioma.
O humor fácil de se identificar do filme fez a plateia rir.

cards.meaning: Easy for people to understand or feel connected to.

English: It was chilly outside, so I put on a jacket.
The evening air felt chilly near the coast.
A chilly wind came through the open window.
Portuguese: Estava frio lá fora, então coloquei uma jaqueta.
O ar da noite estava fresco perto do litoral.
Um vento frio entrou pela janela aberta.

cards.meaning: Unpleasantly cool.

English: The water is boiling, so the pasta is ready.
It was boiling hot inside the crowded bus.
She waited for the boiling kettle to switch off.
Portuguese: A água está fervendo, então dá para colocar o macarrão.
Estava um calor de rachar dentro do ônibus lotado.
Ela esperou a chaleira fervendo desligar.

cards.meaning: At the temperature where liquid turns to gas; also extremely hot.

English: The road was foggy, so we drove slowly.
It gets foggy near the river in the morning.
My glasses became foggy when I entered the warm room.
Portuguese: A estrada estava com neblina, então dirigimos devagar.
Fica enevoado perto do rio de manhã.
Meus óculos embaçaram quando entrei na sala quente.

cards.meaning: Full of fog; also covered in condensation.

English: The children were eager to open their presents.
I'm eager to hear what you think of the idea.
She was eager for the trip to begin.
Portuguese: As crianças estavam ansiosas para abrir os presentes.
Estou ansioso para saber o que você acha da ideia.
Ela estava empolgada para a viagem começar.

cards.meaning: Wanting very much to do or have something.

English: The court ruled that the law was unconstitutional.
They argued that the search was unconstitutional.
The new rule could be challenged as unconstitutional.
Portuguese: O tribunal decidiu que a lei era inconstitucional.
Eles argumentaram que a revista foi inconstitucional.
A nova regra pode ser contestada como inconstitucional.

cards.meaning: Not allowed by a country's constitution.

English: The hospital uses cutting-edge medical equipment.
She works on cutting-edge research in renewable energy.
The company hopes to stay at the cutting edge of design.
Portuguese: O hospital usa equipamentos médicos de ponta.
Ela trabalha em pesquisas de ponta em energia renovável.
A empresa quer continuar na vanguarda do design.

cards.meaning: The most modern and advanced.

English: The road is rough after the heavy rain.
We had a rough week, but things are improving.
Cut the paper into rough circles before shaping them.
Portuguese: A estrada está esburacada depois da chuva forte.
Tivemos uma semana difícil, mas as coisas estão melhorando.
Corte o papel em círculos aproximados antes de modelá-los.

cards.meaning: Not smooth; difficult or unpleasant; not exact.

English: Her calm voice was reassuring during the emergency.
It was reassuring to hear that everyone was safe.
The doctor gave us a reassuring update.
Portuguese: A voz calma dela foi tranquilizadora durante a emergência.
Foi um alívio saber que todos estavam bem.
O médico nos deu uma notícia tranquilizadora.

cards.meaning: Making someone feel less worried.

English: I felt frustrated when the computer froze again.
He was frustrated by the slow progress.
She gets frustrated when people interrupt her.
Portuguese: Fiquei frustrado quando o computador travou de novo.
Ele estava frustrado com o progresso lento.
Ela fica irritada quando as pessoas a interrompem.

cards.meaning: Annoyed because you cannot do or achieve something.

English: The loud music irritated the neighbors.
She felt irritated by the constant interruptions.
His eyes became irritated from the dust.
Portuguese: A música alta irritou os vizinhos.
Ela ficou irritada com as interrupções constantes.
Os olhos dele ficaram irritados por causa da poeira.

cards.meaning: Annoyed; also (of skin or eyes) red and sore.

English: His directions were too vague to follow.
She gave a vague answer about her plans.
I have a vague memory of meeting him before.
Portuguese: As instruções dele eram vagas demais para seguir.
Ela deu uma resposta vaga sobre seus planos.
Tenho uma vaga lembrança de tê-lo conhecido antes.

cards.meaning: Not clear or detailed.

English: He was blunt about the problems with my proposal.
The blunt knife struggled to cut the bread.
She gave me a blunt but useful answer.
Portuguese: Ele foi direto sobre os problemas da minha proposta.
A faca cega mal conseguia cortar o pão.
Ela me deu uma resposta franca, mas útil.

cards.meaning: Saying what you think without trying to be polite; (of a blade) not sharp.

English: It was tactful of her to change the subject.
He gave tactful feedback about the presentation.
Try to be tactful when discussing a sensitive issue.
Portuguese: Foi delicado da parte dela mudar de assunto.
Ele deu um retorno cuidadoso sobre a apresentação.
Tente ter tato ao falar de um assunto delicado.

cards.meaning: Careful not to upset or offend people.

terms.Portuguese: franco; que não tem papas na língua

English: She is outspoken about protecting the environment.
The outspoken journalist challenged the minister.
He became known for his outspoken opinions.
Portuguese: Ela fala abertamente sobre a proteção do meio ambiente.
A jornalista que não tem papas na língua confrontou o ministro.
Ele ficou conhecido pelas opiniões francas.

cards.meaning: Expressing opinions openly, even if they upset people.

English: We found a decent hotel near the station.
He earns a decent salary for his experience.
That was a decent thing to do.
Portuguese: Encontramos um hotel razoável perto da estação.
Ele ganha um salário decente para a experiência que tem.
Foi uma atitude bacana.

cards.meaning: Good enough; acceptable; also kind and honest.

English: The cottage is surrounded by tall trees.
She felt surrounded by supportive friends.
The old town is surrounded by a stone wall.
Portuguese: O chalé é cercado de árvores altas.
Ela se sentiu rodeada de amigos que a apoiavam.
A cidade antiga é cercada por uma muralha de pedra.

cards.meaning: Having something all around.

English: My grandfather prefers old-fashioned manners.
The café serves an old-fashioned dessert.
That payment method seems old-fashioned now.
Portuguese: Meu avô prefere as boas maneiras à moda antiga.
O café serve uma sobremesa tradicional.
Essa forma de pagamento parece antiquada hoje em dia.

cards.meaning: From the past and no longer common or fashionable.

English: They tried a traditional Balinese dish.
Balinese music played during the festival.
She learned about Balinese culture on the trip.
Portuguese: Eles provaram um prato balinês tradicional.
Música balinesa tocava durante o festival.
Ela conheceu a cultura balinesa na viagem.

cards.meaning: From or relating to Bali, Indonesia.

English: The artist created an intricate pattern by hand.
The watch has an intricate mechanism.
We admired the intricate carvings on the door.
Portuguese: O artista criou à mão uma estampa cheia de detalhes.
O relógio tem um mecanismo complexo.
Admiramos os entalhes intrincados da porta.

cards.meaning: Having many small, complicated parts or details.

English: I'm convinced that we made the right choice.
She convinced her brother to come along.
The evidence convinced the jury.
Portuguese: Estou convencido de que fizemos a escolha certa.
Ela convenceu o irmão a ir junto.
As provas convenceram o júri.

cards.meaning: Completely sure; also persuaded someone.

English: We sat in a dim room lit by candles.
The screen became dim in the sunlight.
He could see a dim light at the end of the hallway.
Portuguese: Sentamos numa sala à meia-luz, iluminada por velas.
A tela ficou fraca sob o sol.
Ele via uma luz fraca no fim do corredor.

cards.meaning: Not bright; with little light.

English: The radio was tuned to a local news station.
She tuned the guitar before the performance.
The team is finely tuned to its customers' needs.
Portuguese: O rádio estava sintonizado numa estação de notícias local.
Ela afinou o violão antes da apresentação.
A equipe está muito bem afinada com as necessidades dos clientes.

cards.meaning: Set to a particular station; adjusted to the correct musical pitch; well adapted.

English: Please remain vigilant when crossing the busy road.
The guards stayed vigilant throughout the night.
Parents should be vigilant about online safety.
Portuguese: Por favor, fique atento ao atravessar a rua movimentada.
Os guardas ficaram vigilantes a noite toda.
Os pais devem ficar atentos à segurança on-line.

cards.meaning: Carefully watching for danger or problems.

English: There was a subtle change in her expression.
The sauce has a subtle taste of lemon.
He made a subtle suggestion during the meeting.
Portuguese: Houve uma mudança sutil na expressão dela.
O molho tem um gosto sutil de limão.
Ele fez uma sugestão sutil durante a reunião.

cards.meaning: Small and not obvious, but important or noticeable.

English: We were thrilled to hear the good news.
She was thrilled with her exam results.
I'm thrilled that you can come to the party.
Portuguese: Ficamos muito felizes com a boa notícia.
Ela ficou radiante com o resultado da prova.
Estou empolgado que você vai poder vir à festa.

cards.meaning: Extremely pleased and excited.

English: The mischievous puppy hid one of my shoes.
He gave me a mischievous smile.
The children played a mischievous trick on their teacher.
Portuguese: O filhote arteiro escondeu um dos meus sapatos.
Ele me deu um sorriso travesso.
As crianças pregaram uma peça na professora.

cards.meaning: Playfully causing small trouble.

English: A vicious dog chased the cyclist.
They criticized the article for its vicious tone.
The storm caused a vicious cycle of flooding and damage.
Portuguese: Um cachorro feroz perseguiu o ciclista.
Criticaram o artigo pelo tom cruel.
A tempestade provocou um ciclo vicioso de enchentes e estragos.

cards.meaning: Very violent or aggressive; also intended to hurt.

English: I felt lazy after a big lunch.
The lazy cat slept in the sun all afternoon.
It was a lazy Sunday with no plans.
Portuguese: Fiquei com preguiça depois de um almoço pesado.
O gato preguiçoso dormiu no sol a tarde toda.
Foi um domingo tranquilo, sem planos.

cards.meaning: Not wanting to work or make an effort; also relaxed and slow.

English: I ordered sweet-and-sour chicken with rice.
The sauce tastes sweet and sour.
She made a sweet-and-sour dressing for the salad.
Portuguese: Pedi frango agridoce com arroz.
O molho tem um sabor agridoce.
Ela fez um molho agridoce para a salada.

cards.meaning: Having both a sweet and a sour taste.

English: The course was challenging but worthwhile.
It is worthwhile to compare prices before buying.
Volunteering was a worthwhile experience for him.
Portuguese: O curso foi desafiador, mas valeu a pena.
Vale a pena comparar preços antes de comprar.
Ser voluntário foi uma experiência proveitosa para ele.

cards.meaning: Worth the time, money, or effort.

English: It is pointless to argue about something we cannot change.
The search seemed pointless until they found the key.
He felt the meeting was pointless without a clear goal.
Portuguese: É inútil discutir sobre algo que não podemos mudar.
A busca parecia inútil até encontrarem a chave.
Ele achou a reunião sem sentido, sem um objetivo claro.

cards.meaning: Having no purpose or useful result.

English: Could you spare a few minutes to help me?
This tire is a spare in case one goes flat.
The nurse tried to spare him unnecessary pain.
Portuguese: Você poderia me dar alguns minutos para me ajudar?
Este pneu é o estepe, caso algum fure.
A enfermeira tentou poupá-lo de dor desnecessária.

cards.meaning: Extra, kept in case it is needed; to give time or something you can do without; to save someone from something.

English: That explanation sounds a little far-fetched.
It is not far-fetched to think prices may rise.
Her story seemed far-fetched at first, but it was true.
Portuguese: Essa explicação parece um pouco forçada.
Não é absurdo pensar que os preços podem subir.
A história dela pareceu improvável no começo, mas era verdade.

cards.meaning: Very unlikely to be true; hard to believe.

English: The inquisitive child asked questions about everything.
She has an inquisitive mind and loves learning.
The dog gave me an inquisitive look.
Portuguese: A criança curiosa fazia perguntas sobre tudo.
Ela tem uma mente curiosa e adora aprender.
O cachorro me lançou um olhar curioso.

cards.meaning: Wanting to learn and asking many questions.

English: The clinic offers free transport for elderly patients.
An elderly neighbor helped us carry the groceries.
The building has an elevator for elderly residents.
Portuguese: A clínica oferece transporte gratuito para pacientes idosos.
Um vizinho idoso nos ajudou a carregar as compras.
O prédio tem elevador para os moradores idosos.

cards.meaning: Old (a polite word for older people).

English: She is keen to learn how the machine works.
He is keen on playing tennis after work.
The students were keen to join the science club.
Portuguese: Ela está interessada em aprender como a máquina funciona.
Ele adora jogar tênis depois do trabalho.
Os alunos estavam animados para entrar no clube de ciências.

cards.meaning: Very interested and eager to do something.

English: The new employee is always punctual.
Please be punctual for your interview.
The train service is usually punctual.
Portuguese: O novo funcionário é sempre pontual.
Por favor, seja pontual na sua entrevista.
O serviço de trem costuma ser pontual.

cards.meaning: Arriving or doing something at the expected time.

English: The table has a smooth surface.
We had a smooth journey despite the rain.
Use a spoon to make the sauce smooth.
Portuguese: A mesa tem uma superfície lisa.
Fizemos uma viagem tranquila apesar da chuva.
Use uma colher para deixar o molho homogêneo.

cards.meaning: Having an even surface; happening without problems.

English: Be careful when you cross the busy street.
He was careful to check every detail.
Please be careful with that glass bowl.
Portuguese: Tenha cuidado ao atravessar a rua movimentada.
Ele teve o cuidado de verificar cada detalhe.
Por favor, tome cuidado com essa tigela de vidro.

cards.meaning: Giving attention to avoid harm or mistakes.

English: The response seemed disproportionate to the mistake.
The punishment was disproportionate to the offense.
Rent takes up a disproportionate share of his income.
Portuguese: A reação pareceu desproporcional ao erro.
A punição foi desproporcional à infração.
O aluguel consome uma parcela desproporcional da renda dele.

cards.meaning: Too large or small in relation to something else.

English: They built a long-lasting friendship.
The treatment provided long-lasting relief.
We want a long-lasting solution to the problem.
Portuguese: Eles construíram uma amizade duradoura.
O tratamento proporcionou um alívio duradouro.
Queremos uma solução duradoura para o problema.

cards.meaning: Continuing for a long time.

English: The report was discredited by new evidence.
The theory was discredited after repeated failed experiments.
The witness was discredited when her story changed.
Portuguese: O relatório perdeu a credibilidade diante de novas evidências.
A teoria foi desacreditada após vários experimentos fracassados.
A testemunha perdeu a credibilidade quando sua versão mudou.

cards.meaning: Shown to be untrustworthy or false.

English: This small café is an underrated place for lunch.
That actor is underrated despite his excellent performances.
Walking is an underrated form of exercise.
Portuguese: Este pequeno café é um lugar subestimado para almoçar.
Aquele ator é subestimado apesar de suas excelentes atuações.
Caminhar é uma forma subestimada de exercício.

cards.meaning: Not valued or recognized as highly as it deserves.

English: We had homemade soup for dinner.
She brought homemade bread to the picnic.
This homemade sauce tastes better than the bottled one.
Portuguese: Tomamos sopa caseira no jantar.
Ela levou pão caseiro para o piquenique.
Este molho caseiro é mais gostoso do que o engarrafado.

cards.meaning: Made at home rather than commercially.

English: They faced a formidable opponent in the final.
Climbing the mountain was a formidable challenge.
Her formidable debating skills impressed the audience.
Portuguese: Eles enfrentaram um adversário formidável na final.
Escalar a montanha foi um desafio formidável.
A impressionante habilidade dela nos debates impressionou o público.

cards.meaning: Inspiring respect or fear because of great size, strength, or difficulty.

English: The brave firefighter entered the building.
She was brave enough to speak in front of the crowd.
The brave child stayed calm during the rescue.
Portuguese: O bombeiro corajoso entrou no prédio.
Ela foi corajosa o bastante para falar diante da multidão.
A criança corajosa manteve a calma durante o resgate.

cards.meaning: Showing courage in a difficult or dangerous situation.

English: It is rare to see snow in this region.
This museum owns several rare books.
A quiet afternoon is rare in this busy office.
Portuguese: É raro nevar nesta região.
Este museu possui vários livros raros.
Uma tarde tranquila é rara neste escritório movimentado.

cards.meaning: Not common or occurring infrequently.

English: The hikers were unprepared for the extreme heat.
The plants cannot survive in extreme cold.
The region has experienced extreme drought this year.
Portuguese: Os caminhantes não estavam preparados para o calor extremo.
As plantas não conseguem sobreviver ao frio extremo.
A região enfrentou uma seca extrema neste ano.

cards.meaning: Very great in degree or intensity; the greatest possible degree.

English: It was obvious that he was tired.
The answer seemed obvious once she explained it.
There was an obvious mistake in the calculation.
Portuguese: Era óbvio que ele estava cansado.
A resposta pareceu óbvia depois que ela explicou.
Havia um erro evidente no cálculo.

cards.meaning: Easy to notice or understand.

English: He was unwilling to share the details.
She seemed unwilling to change her plans.
They were unwilling to accept the offer.
Portuguese: Ele não estava disposto a compartilhar os detalhes.
Ela parecia relutante em mudar seus planos.
Eles não estavam dispostos a aceitar a oferta.

cards.meaning: Not wanting to do something.

English: The course gives a broad overview of history.
The book covers a broad range of topics.
She has a broad knowledge of European history.
Portuguese: O curso oferece uma visão geral ampla da história.
O livro aborda uma ampla variedade de temas.
Ela tem um amplo conhecimento da história europeia.

cards.meaning: Wide in extent or covering many areas.

English: Starting her own company was a bold decision.
He made a bold proposal to change the entire system.
Her bold approach impressed the investors.
Portuguese: Abrir a própria empresa foi uma decisão ousada.
Ele fez uma proposta audaciosa para mudar o sistema inteiro.
A abordagem ousada dela impressionou os investidores.

cards.meaning: Confident and willing to take risks or act decisively.

English: His reckless driving put everyone at risk.
It was reckless to swim during the storm.
He made a reckless decision without considering the risks.
Portuguese: A direção imprudente dele colocou todos em risco.
Foi imprudente nadar durante a tempestade.
Ele tomou uma decisão imprudente sem considerar os riscos.

cards.meaning: Acting without enough care for danger or consequences.

English: My grandmother gave me some wise advice.
Saving some money for emergencies is a wise decision.
It would be wise to check the weather before leaving.
Portuguese: Minha avó me deu alguns conselhos sábios.
Guardar um pouco de dinheiro para emergências é uma decisão sensata.
Seria sensato conferir a previsão do tempo antes de sair.

cards.meaning: Showing good judgment based on knowledge or experience.

English: The water is shallow near the shore.
We crossed the river at a shallow spot.
The children played in a shallow pool.
Portuguese: A água é rasa perto da margem.
Atravessamos o rio em um trecho raso.
As crianças brincaram em uma piscina rasa.

cards.meaning: Having little distance from the surface to the bottom.

English: These shoes are suitable for hiking.
We need to find a suitable place for the meeting.
This film is suitable for young children.
Portuguese: Estes sapatos são adequados para caminhadas em trilhas.
Precisamos encontrar um lugar adequado para a reunião.
Este filme é apropriado para crianças pequenas.

cards.meaning: Right or appropriate for a particular person or purpose.

English: The frightened child held his mother's hand.
I was frightened by the loud noise.
She is frightened of flying.
Portuguese: A criança assustada segurou a mão da mãe.
Fiquei assustado com o barulho alto.
Ela tem medo de voar.

cards.meaning: Feeling fear or alarm.

English: Be careful, the floor is uneven here.
The paint looks uneven on this wall.
The team's performance has been uneven this season.
Portuguese: Cuidado, o chão é desnivelado aqui.
A tinta parece irregular nesta parede.
O desempenho do time tem sido irregular nesta temporada.

cards.meaning: Not level, smooth, or consistent in surface, quality, or distribution.

English: Women often receive unequal pay for the same work.
The two pieces of cake were unequal in size.
It was an unequal fight from the start.
Portuguese: As mulheres muitas vezes recebem salários desiguais pelo mesmo trabalho.
Os dois pedaços de bolo tinham tamanhos diferentes.
Foi uma luta desigual desde o começo.

cards.meaning: Not the same in size, amount, or value; not fair or balanced between people or groups.

English: I felt deceived when I found out the truth.
Many customers were deceived by the fake advertisement.
Don't be deceived by his friendly smile.
Portuguese: Eu me senti enganado quando descobri a verdade.
Muitos clientes foram enganados pelo anúncio falso.
Não se deixe enganar pelo sorriso simpático dele.

cards.meaning: Tricked into believing something that is not true.

English: I'm really thirsty after that long run.
The kids were hot and thirsty, so we bought some water.
Salty food always makes me thirsty.
Portuguese: Estou com muita sede depois daquela corrida longa.
As crianças estavam com calor e com sede, então compramos água.
Comida salgada sempre me dá sede.

cards.meaning: Feeling a need or desire to drink something.
